label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP: java.util.Random().nextInt() is used to generate rememberMeKey which is stored in session/cookie - weak PRNG for auth tokens is a real vulnerability. Alert 2 (java/xss) is FP: user input (param from getTheValue) flows to bar variable but bar is never used in the print statement at lines 106-111; those lines use user (derived from class name), rememberMe.getName(), and rememberMe.getValue() - none contain user input.

evidence.note: java.util.Random().nextInt() generates insecure randomness for rememberMeKey used in session/cookie
user input param assigned to bar but bar is unused in output
print statement uses user/classname-derived values, not user input
